core_obligations: Choose the triangle defining K (proof lines 23472-23486): since any such K must fit in the blow-up descent triangle, simply take the distinguished triangle K -> Ri_*(L) + Rb_*(K') -> Rc_*(L|_E) -> K[1], where c = i o pi, the map Ri_*(L) -> Rc_*(L|_E) is Ri_* applied to the adjunction map L -> R pi_*(L|_E), and the map Rb_*(K') -> Rc_*(L|_E) is the composite of the canonical map Rb_*(K') -> Rc_*(K'|_E) with Rc_*(gamma); the maps g and f of the statement are the adjoints of these two maps.

Show g is an isomorphism (proof lines 23487-23493): restricting the triangle to Z turns the map Rb_*(K') -> Rc_*(L|_E) into an isomorphism by the base change theorem, hence the adjoint map g : K|_Z -> L is an isomorphism.

Show f is an isomorphism (proof lines 23494-23501): the triangle shows that f : K|_{X'} -> K' is an isomorphism over X' minus E, and by construction gamma composed with f|_E equals g|_E; since gamma and g are isomorphisms, f induces isomorphisms on stalks at the geometric points of E as well, so f is an isomorphism.

Prove the final (morphism) part (proof lines 23503-23512): replace K' by K|_{X'}, L by K|_Z and gamma by the canonical identification; then alpha and beta induce the displayed commutative square, and the axioms of a triangulated category produce the dotted arrow giving a morphism of distinguished triangles, whose restrictions to X' and to Z are the asserted composites.
proof_roadmap: Construct K by the blow-up descent triangle, with the two maps into Rc_*(L|_E) given by adjunction and by gamma.
Restrict to Z and use proper base change to see that g is an isomorphism; restrict to X' and argue separately outside and above E to see that f is an isomorphism.
For the morphism part, normalise gamma to the canonical identification and complete the map of triangles using the axioms of a triangulated category.
difficulty_reason: The lemma is the descent statement for the blow-up square: data K' on X' and L on Z with an identification of their pullbacks to E glue to an object K on X, functorially in morphisms (statement lines 23436-23469). The proof (proof lines 23471-23512) builds K by the blow-up descent triangle with the two structure maps defined by adjunction and by gamma, proves that both comparison maps are isomorphisms — the first by proper base change after restricting to Z, the second by the separate cases outside E and above E — and then normalises gamma and completes a map of triangles by the axioms of a triangulated category. H2: an explicit construction plus two isomorphism checks, all written out.
